last_episode_to_air.overview: James' courageous appearance at the gala has consequences: his father, Mortimer, forbids him to contact Ruby. To protect their love, they both decide to keep their relationship a secret. But Elaine's invitation to a White Party threatens their secret.

Their passionate exchange of words unexpectedly ignites a spark...

While she tries to suppress her feelings, the remorseful James does everything he can to win her heart back - whatever the cost.

tagline: At this school, class is everything.

results.name: MAXTON HALL – The World Between Us Trailer (2024) Damian Hardung
My Lady Jane
results.overview: Gird your loins for the tragic tale of Lady Jane Grey, the young Tudor noblewoman who was Queen of England for nine days and then beheaded, back in good ol’ 1553. Actually... f*ck that. We’re retelling history the way it should have happened: the damsel in distress saves herself. This is an epic tale of true love and high adventure set in an alt-universe of action, history, fantasy, comedy, romance, and rompy-pompy. Buckle up.

results.name: My Life with the Walter Boys
results.original_name: My Life with the Walter Boys
results.overview: When a tragedy disrupts her life, a teen moves in with her guardian's big family in a small town and learns new lessons about love, hope and friendship.

results.name: Per Elisa: An Italian Crime Story
results.overview: Reconstruction of one of the most shocking crime news events in recent decades: the murders of Elisa Claps and Heather Barnett by Danilo Restivo. The story begins on 12 September 1993 and takes place over a period of about twenty years between Potenza and the English coast of Bournemouth.

results.name: Joko Anwar's Nightmares and Daydreams
results.overview: Tales of supernatural sci-fi phenomena unfold in this collection of seven mind-bending, interconnected stories imagined by writer-director Joko Anwar.

results.name: Nobody Wants This
results.overview: An agnostic sex podcaster and a newly single rabbi fall in love, but can their relationship survive their wildly different lives and meddling families?

results.name: Geek Girl
results.overview: Awkward teen Harriet has always wanted to fit in. Until she gets scouted by a top London model agent and learns that some people are meant to stand out.

results.name: A Good Girl's Guide to Murder
results.original_name: A Good Girl's Guide to Murder
results.overview: Five years after the death of schoolgirl Andie Bell, Pippa Fitz-Amobi sets out to uncover what really happened to her. Sal Singh, Andie's boyfriend, admitted to the murder before taking his own life, but Pip doesn't believe he's responsible and teams up with Sal's brother Ravi to uncover the truth. If Sal Singh isn't a murderer and the real killer is still out there, how far will they go to keep Pip from finding out the truth?

results.name: The Summer I Turned Pretty
results.overview: Every summer, Belly and her family head to the Fishers’ beach house in Cousins. Every summer is the same ... until Belly turns sixteen. Relationships will be tested, painful truths will be revealed, and Belly will be forever changed. It’s a summer of first love, first heartbreak and growing up — it's the summer she turns pretty.

results.name: Grotesquerie
results.overview: A series of heinous crimes have unsettled a small community, and Detective Lois Tryon feels they are eerily personal, as if someone—or something—is taunting her.

results.name: Outer Banks
results.overview: A tight-knit group of teens unearths a long-buried secret, setting off a chain of illicit events that takes them on an adventure they'll never forget.

results.name: Degrassi: Next Class
results.overview: Follow a group of high school freshmen, sophomores, juniors, and seniors from Degrassi Community School, a fictional school in Toronto, Ontario, as they encounter some of the typical issues and challenges common to a teenager's life.

results.name: Swimming with Sharks
results.overview: When Lou Simms starts her internship at Fountain Pictures she seems like a naïve Hollywood newcomer, awestruck by the studio’s notorious CEO, Joyce Holt. In truth, Lou has done extensive research on Joyce and landing this internship was no happy accident. As Lou’s obsession grows, she will do anything to get close to her idol.

results.name: Harlan Coben's Shelter
results.overview: Follow the story of Mickey Bolitar after the death of his father leads him to start a new life in suburban New Jersey. When another new student disappears, Mickey finds himself tangled in a web of secrets. With the help of two new friends, Spoon and Ema, they reveal a dark underground that may hold the answers to decades of disappearances.

results.name: Máxima
results.overview: From the moment Máxima Zorreguieta appears at the Dutch crown prince’s side, she finds herself in the spotlight. When Willem-Alexander asks her to marry him, the past catches up with her. Heated discussion erupts about her father’s political career in the Videla regime – a discussion she never faced in her own circles. What allows this Argentine to finally thrive at an old European court? And how can Máxima stay true to herself without giving up her family – or do these things not go together?

results.name: Hotel Cocaine
results.overview: The story of Roman Compte, a Cuban exile and general manager of The Mutiny Hotel, the glamorous epicenter of the Miami cocaine scene of late '70s and early '80s. The Mutiny Hotel was Casablanca on cocaine.

results.name: Snakes and Ladders
results.overview: An ambitious but overlooked teacher wants to be head of a prestigious school, but must climb a slippery ladder of lies and corruption to reach the top.

results.name: LOL: Last One Laughing Germany - Halloween Special
results.original_name: LOL: Last One Laughing - Halloween Special
results.overview: To celebrate Halloween, LOL will be airing a surprise special edition of the show packed with unnaturally funny jokes!

results.name: Mary & George
results.overview: In 17th century England, Mary Villiers molds her beautiful son, George, to seduce King James I, intending to gain riches and influence through outrageous schemes.

results.name: Dancing with the Stars: Juniors
results.overview: A fresh take on an established favorite in which 12 celebrity kids will be partnered with professional junior ballroom dancers to perform choreographed routines.

results.name: Cindy la Regia: The High School Years
results.overview: Cindy, a sharp and restless teenager, grows up happily in the high society of San Pedro Garza García in Nuevo León. When she and her longtime friends enter coeducational high school for the first time, Cindy questions the role of "princess" and the search for "prince charming" she's always been taught. In her freshman adventures, Cindy learns that pleasing others doesn't matter as much as finding herself.
